notes.title: Kana no Mado - Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Fixes


 Fixed an issue where restarting a Katakana practice session at the end of the quiz would incorrectly start a Hiragana session. Restart now always resumes the same practice mode that was just completed.
 Improved internal mode sync on scene start to prevent rare mismatches between selected mode and displayed content.

notes.title: Kana no Mado - Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674245/dd59f4d50c16c2b60bdc38852ed5910671f09f16.png"]



The new version 1.1.0 introduces additional options in the Options menu:

Display Mode: Windowed, Borderless Window, Fullscreen

Resolution Presets: Support for both 16:9 and 16:10 monitors 

This should make the game more comfortable to play across a wider range of screens and setups, including ultrawide and Steam Deck.  

📌 How to use
Open the game, go to Menu → Options, and choose the configuration that best fits your screen. 

🛠️ More improvements coming soon
 Thanks again for your feedback! I’m continuing to work on further improvements.
